children.text: The October 1973 incident which has come to be known as the Pascagoula Encounter was an alleged UFO sighting and alien abduction where Charles Hickson and Calvin Parker claimed to be abducted by aliens while fishing near Pascagoula, Mississippi. Charles Hickson passed away in 2011 at the age of 81. The video is uploaded for discussion between those who would share the evidence supporting the conclusion that this report is a hoax as well as from those who believe it to be genuine.
